# v2026.11.6

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.11.6.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.11.6.md).

This release covers **4 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- A Flow code linked to a Xero item sends as that item, so many work-system products can share one Xero item. ([#500](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/500))
- New rule fields "Every item is in accounting" and "Remake": a lab can hold a job with an item Xero does not sell, and put every remake on Non-chargeable. ([#500](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/500))
- A matching non-chargeable rule now wins over wait rules, and old held history jobs with no accounting invoice settle by rule. ([#500](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/500))
- Sentry events hold no private words, and problem-report screenshots are off by default. ([#497](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/497))

## Changes

- A Flow code linked to a Xero item sends as that item; a new setting `XERO_LINE_TEXT=item` puts the Xero item's name on each line. ([#500](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/500))
- New rule fields "Every item is in accounting" and "Remake". ([#500](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/500))
- Sentry events hold no private words, and problem-report screenshots are off by default. ([#497](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/497))

## Fixes

- A matching non-chargeable rule now wins over wait rules, and old held history jobs with no accounting invoice settle by rule. ([#500](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/500))
- A price list Flow cannot read now shows as "not read" instead of "no differences". ([#500](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/500))
